items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:1:1
items.html: The second Ibur [impregnation], for the need of the Mochin of birth: It is the Ibur that comes after nine years and one day, for then it is fit for the Mochin of birth. And this Ibur is sometimes called, in the words of the ARI, by the name the third Ibur, and this is for the reason that there is an Ibur that comes after the two years of nursing, for the attainment of GAR of Ruach, which is the second Ibur, as above. (Part 12, item 102) And this Ibur, which comes for the need of the Mochin of Gadlut [greatness/adulthood], is called the third Ibur, or the second Ibur of Mochin, and this is to exclude it from the second Ibur that comes after the two years, which is not for the discernment of Mochin, but rather for the completion of GAR of Ruach, as stated there. Study it there well.
